tasks.card: Add bridge_pair.validate_pair(record) and load_pair(path), reusing bridge_connection validation helpers and v0.12 local Port/frame/region/provenance conventions. Exact narrow input example is tools/pair_acceptance.py:fixture: four stable ports, two connections with explicit track_id/start_port/end_port; no nearest-coordinate pairing. Return equal validated data without mutation, reject malformed/unknown fields and duplicate JSON/IDs/reused ports with ValueError. Preserve supplied unit travel tangents, including explicitly opposing B travel; do not reverse input silently. Retain min radius, spacing, min separation, maximum length/candidates, curvature depth, lowering/read-back tolerances and source_refs/project_choices/assumptions. Only level equal elevation, zero grade/cant; unsupported arrangements must be distinguishable. Geometric compatibility (parallel endpoint pairs, equal normal spacing at both ends, +/-45 degree heading) is classified by L10; do not move endpoints. Author pair_example.json and minimal pair_snapshot_example.json in the exact authored mock form tools/pair_acceptance.py:snapshot. No new general schema, fitting, plan or execution yet. Add focused tests/test_pair_input.py; keep STATE.md short with actual checks and pending host acceptance.

Add bridge_pair.fit_pair(record) returning pair_ready/candidate or invalid_input, unsupported_input, failed_checks, no_accepted_candidate, incomplete_search with candidate=null for failure. Reuse L07 fitting on the pair centreline and Bezier derivative/curvature/subdivision primitives. Support compatible normal-spaced parallel port pairs, equal spacing at both ends, arbitrary map translation/rotation and existing +/-45-degree relative headings. Explicitly account for opposing direction through connection references; preserve each supplied travel tangent. Smallest family: genuine +/-spacing/2 normal offsets of the checked centreline, with direction-aware evaluation point_at(candidate,track_id,t) and tangent_at returning 3D position/unit travel tangent for t in [0,1]. No map-axis-shift substitution. Require zero endpoint curvature compatibility; return unsupported for incompatible pairs. Certify both offset regularity (1-offset*curvature>0), radius, ordering, continuous separation/region and length with conservative derivative/hull/subdivision bounds; retain numerical allowances and finite budgets, not sample-only proof. Existing Alignment formulas are reference only: its fixed knot slopes cannot replace nonparallel endpoint constraints. Record analytic geometry, finite-search exhaustion, pair certificates, provenance and content candidate_hash. No selected partial-search winner or lowered hard constraint. Add independent tests/test_pair_geometry.py for straight, rotated, 30-degree curves, opposing/swapped directions, tight spacing/radius, crossed pairing, region and budgets. No lowering or adapters. Update short state.

Add bridge_pair_mock.compile_pair_plan(candidate,record,snapshot) for an accepted pair. Reuse railcorridor.adapter operation hashing/payload conventions and applicable railbranch current-payload/topology conventions; preserve historical adapters. New module is a narrow offline adaptation, not general architecture. Authored snapshot follows tools/pair_acceptance.py:snapshot: mock environment, identity/revision, four ports and protected neighbours. Reject forged/mismatched candidate/input/hash, port positions/tangents/IDs and unsupported snapshot before any effects. Bind snapshot content hash/revision, candidate hash and input hash. Emit exactly two physical track operations (one per track, never both directions duplicated), explicit stable attachment node IDs, deterministic asset/operation IDs, dependencies, capabilities, direction metadata and plan_hash; real_game_execution_authorised:false. Lower analytic offsets to 3D polylines only with a recorded conservative approximation error bound and finite point budget; retain endpoint directions and avoid claiming polygonal geometry is exact smooth curvature. Check lowered error against spacing/region allowances and read-back tolerance; unsupported lowering must fail. Neighbours remain outside the edit set. Add tests/test_pair_plan.py for determinism, explicit pairing, forgery/staleness, duplicate physical edges, capability/dependency and bound failures. No execution yet. Update short state.

Add bridge_pair_mock.PairMock(snapshot) and execute_pair(plan,adapter), reusing existing reconciliation/lost-acknowledgement approach with narrow adaptation. PairMock exposes current tracks (asset-key -> physical payload including points/start_node/end_node and direction metadata), nodes, revision, writes and fault controls drop_ack_at/fail_at/snap_at. Keep receipts separate from mutable current realised state: verify both actual tracks, four stable attachments, direction metadata and all protected neighbours on every successful response including repeated calls. Compile/execute reject stale snapshot or capabilities before writes; account only for this plans own known partial effects on retries. Clean outcome mock_verified; partial/lost-ack/mismatch outcomes retain visible effects and no rollback claim. Same-instance repeats must not duplicate writes, but stale receipts never hide displaced geometry/wrong connection or changed neighbours. Add tests/test_pair_mock.py: clean, same-instance repeat, ack lost after effect, partial failure, displaced geometry, bad connection/direction, changed neighbour, stale snapshot/revision and capability denial. No database, persistence, automatic resume or game actions. State explicitly that new process means new mock world. Update short state.

Add bridge_app.connect_pair(input_path,output,mock_execute=False,snapshot_path=None) and CLI connect-pair --input FILE --output DIRECTORY [--mock-execute --snapshot FILE]. Default design-only: do not load or execute adapter/plan automatically. Explicit mock needs the authored snapshot and one fresh in-memory instance. Reuse existing atomic run.json, artifact paths/hashes, status, verify and output protection; extend supported mode/outcome validation narrowly and preserve corridor/single-track old records. Save complete pair geometry/checks/provenance; mock mode additionally saves bound plan, snapshot and current read-back/partial effects using existing artifacts where appropriate. Distinguish pair_ready design checks, mock_verified realised current-state checks, file integrity and unprobed real game; always game_constructed:false and <=4096-byte stdout. Fresh status/verify must not import/call fitting/construction. Preserve failure and unfinished records honestly. Add tests/test_pair_app.py for callable/CLI parity, explicit mock requirement, fresh inspection, invalid/stale/missing/corrupt records, output refusal, compact output and forbidden design/execution calls during inspection. Update USAGE.md briefly and short state. No new persistence system or other feature.

Combined acceptance and short usage/implementation-to-test record only. Demonstrate pair_example.json -> checked design -> explicit bound mock plan -> current read-back for both connections and preserved neighbours; include representative invalid/stale/corrupted-result scenarios and fresh-process status/verify without construction. Reuse implemented functionality and existing tests. Document runnable API/CLI commands, finite geometry family, normal-offset/approximation certificates and limits, same-instance idempotency versus fresh-process mock, explicit game_constructed:false, preserved legacy commands and no live game capability claim. Write a compact mapping of L09-L13 requirements to test file/cases in USAGE.md; detailed results remain local. Add missing acceptance cases only in tests/test_pair_acceptance.py, no application feature/code changes; report any out-of-scope defect and stop. Host executes all queued combined checks; do not duplicate passing test runs in worker. Update STATE.md concisely with actual evidence/pending host checks and stop at L14.
